draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.39, the 29th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 5th of 32 at WR. He went 21st overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Alshon Jeffery. Testing standouts: vertical jump (92nd percentile), broad jump (93rd percentile). College production: 1,069 receiving yards in 2022, 9th of 32 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Chargers. 46 career games and 31 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 6 AV in 2025 against a career-best 7 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: receiving td 8 (93rd percentile), drop rate 2.4% (80th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 wide receiver who played: 735 receiving yards against a median of 346, above the norm.
